sections.title: PawSharp.Gateway
sections.content:
PawSharp.Gateway

Manages multiple gateway shards for large bots. Provides automatic shard distribution, reconnection, status monitoring, and event aggregation.

sections.content:
PawSharp.Gateway.Events.EventDispatcherIntentExtensions

Methods

ValidateHandlerIntents(EventDispatcher dispatcher, GatewayIntents enabledIntents, ILogger logger)

Validates that all registered handlers have their required intents enabled. Logs warnings for any mismatches.

ParameterDescription
dispatcherThe event dispatcher to validate
enabledIntentsThe intents that are currently enabled
loggerOptional logger for warnings. If null, uses console.WriteLine

GetRegisteredIntents(EventDispatcher dispatcher)

Gets a summary of all event interests registered in the dispatcher. Useful for debugging and logging the dispatcher's current configuration.

ParameterDescription
dispatcherThe event dispatcher to examine

Returns: A list of (EventType, RequiredIntents) tuples

GetRecommendedIntents(EventDispatcher dispatcher)

Gets a recommended set of intents based on all currently registered handlers. This can be used to suggest what intents the client should enable.

ParameterDescription
dispatcherThe event dispatcher to examine

Returns: A bitmask of recommended intents

sections.title: PawSharp.Gateway.Events.VoiceChannelEffectSendEvent
sections.content:
PawSharp.Gateway.Events.VoiceChannelEffectSendEvent

Properties

ChannelId

The ID of the channel the effect was sent in.

GuildId

The ID of the guild.

UserId

The ID of the user who sent the effect.

Emoji

The emoji sent (null if a soundboard sound was used instead).

AnimationType

The type of emoji animation: 0 = PREMIUM (super-reaction), 1 = BASIC. Null when a soundboard sound is the effect.

SoundId

The ID of the soundboard sound, if the effect is a soundboard sound.

SoundVolume

The volume of the soundboard sound, from 0 to 1. Null when not a soundboard effect.

sections.title: PawSharp.Gateway.GatewayClient
sections.content:
PawSharp.Gateway.GatewayClient

Methods

UpdatePresenceAsync()

Update client presence/status (Opcode 3).

RequestGuildMembersAsync()

Request guild members list (Opcode 8). Used for member chunking. Provide for targeted member fetches (mutually exclusive with ).

RequestSoundboardSoundsAsync(UInt64[] guildIds)

Requests soundboard sounds for one or more guilds (Opcode 31). Discord will respond with a GUILD_SOUNDBOARD_SOUNDS_UPDATE event for each requested guild.

ParameterDescription
guildIdsThe IDs of the guilds whose soundboard sounds to request.

ReconnectAsync()

Gracefully reconnect with exponential backoff on transient errors.

GatewaySendAsync()

Sends a serialised payload through the WebSocket, optionally subject to the 120-commands-per-60-second gateway rate limit. Heartbeat opcodes (op 1) should pass  =  to bypass the throttle — they must always be sent on time to keep the connection alive.

SendVoiceStateUpdateAsync(ulong guildId, Nullable<ulong> channelId, bool selfMute, bool selfDeaf)

Sends a voice state update to the gateway.

ParameterDescription
guildIdThe guild ID.
channelIdThe channel ID to join (null to leave).
selfMuteWhether to mute self.
selfDeafWhether to deafen self.
